title: Evaluating large language model`s performance in answering principles of health course questions
task: Comparative performance evaluation of large language models on health education assessment
key_results: ChatGPT-4o and Perplexity 2.250619.0 achieved highest accuracy (0.93) and specificity (0.8); all LLMs achieved perfect sensitivity (1.0); performance declined with question complexity and length
comments: The evaluation relies on confusion matrix metrics but lacks domain-expert validation; perfect sensitivity may reflect over-permissive scoring rather than true comprehension.

inputs: Principles of Health course questions (varying complexity and length)
outputs: Sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV, overall accuracy scores

hypotheses.hypothesis: LLM performance correlates inversely with question complexity and verbosity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; performance declined as questionnaire item complexity increased

hypotheses.hypothesis: Certain LLMs struggle with quantitative questions involving numerical data
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for Copilot; demonstrated particular difficulty with numerical reasoning

title: Application of nanopore adaptive sampling for metagenomic detection of tick-borne RNA viruses
task: Tick-borne RNA virus detection and assembly using nanopore adaptive sampling
key_results: High-resolution Dabieshan tick virus (DTV) genome assembly achieved from single ticks despite low viral RNA abundance; first confirmation of DTV presence and genotypes in Republic of Korea with phylogenetic clustering to China/Japan isolates
comments: Adaptive sampling effectively overcomes host nucleic acid contamination and suboptimal cDNA fragment sizes, making single-tick surveillance practical for emerging pathogen monitoring.

model_io.model: Nanopore adaptive sampling (NAS) with long-read sequencing

hypotheses.hypothesis: NAS improves genome assembly quality compared to conventional nanopore workflows under suboptimal fragment-size conditions
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; NAS enabled single-tick viral genome assembly superior to pooled-sample approaches

hypotheses.hypothesis: DTV circulates regionally in East Asia facilitated by H. longicornis distribution
hypotheses.result: Supported; detected DTV sequences clustered with China and Japan isolates

title: A machine learning-driven framework integrating cell death and senescence signatures for multi-target drug design and immunotherapy optimization in ovarian cancer
task: Machine learning integration of cell death/senescence signatures for ovarian cancer drug design and immunotherapy optimization
key_results: Cell Death and Senescence Learning Signature (CDSLS) validated across 1858 OC samples; RB1 overexpression induced senescence and enhanced CD8+ T-cell activation; in vivo RB1-overexpressing tumors showed restrained growth with elevated immune infiltration
comments: The framework successfully bridges molecular signatures and functional validation, though the identified compounds remain computationally predicted and require experimental validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: High CDSLS scores predict poor survival and immunosuppression
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in multi-cohort validation

hypotheses.hypothesis: RB1 regulates senescence and impacts CD8+ T-cell activation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; RB1 overexpression induced senescence, DNA damage signaling, and enhanced T-cell activation

hypotheses.hypothesis: CDSLS predicts differential drug sensitivity to specific agents
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; signature linked to brivanib, azacitidine, and other agent responses

title: A hybrid artificial neural network-random forest model for enhanced wet bulb temperature prediction in arid urban environments
task: Hybrid ANN-RF model for wet bulb temperature prediction
key_results: Hybrid ANN–RF achieves validation R² 0.997, RMSE 0.150; 28.6% error reduction vs. best standalone models
comments: Well-motivated ensemble combining complementary strengths; 42-year historical data provides strong evidence, though generalization to other arid regions unclear.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid ANN–RF combines ANN nonlinear capacity with RF stability, improving generalization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; hybrid achieves better validation RMSE and R² than standalone models

title: Development and simulation of an innovative autonomous knowledge-based smart waste collection system
key_results: KWC reduces travel distance 60.9%, collected bins 89%, collection days 10%; 63% cost reduction vs. conventional collection
comments: Pragmatic cloud-based alternative to hardware-intensive sensor systems; life-cycle costing analysis strengthens practical value, though single residential district limits transferability.

model_io.model: XGBoost, Random Forest, SVM, GLM, DNN (waste forecasting)
inputs: onboard-truck historical waste sensor data per bin
outputs: daily waste generation prediction per bin

hypotheses.hypothesis: XGBoost outperforms other ML algorithms on waste forecasting via nonlinear interaction modeling
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 4.2% relative error and RMSE 0.47

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cloud-based KWC outperforms hardware-intensive SWC economically
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; KWC achieves 63% cost reduction vs. 5% for SWC

title: Deep deterministic policy gradient based routing protocol for UWSNs
task: Energy-efficient routing in underwater sensor networks
key_results: D2PG-RP outperforms Q-learning baselines in energy consumption, network lifetime, end-to-end delay, and packet delivery ratio
comments: Addresses practical UWSN challenges but lacks quantitative performance metrics (exact percentage improvements not stated in abstract).

inputs: depth, propagation delay, residual energy, NMF, NRS, AIL

hypotheses.hypothesis: Actor-critic network with multi-parameter reward function mitigates void node problem
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; demonstrates improved performance over legacy Q-learning

title: A new perspective on data leakage prevention and adaptive attention in telecom churn prediction
task: Customer churn prediction with leakage-free preprocessing
key_results: LOP-Net achieves 96% accuracy and Brier score ~3%; statistical significance confirmed with p-values < 5%
comments: Strong contribution on data leakage mitigation, though the novelty of LOP-Attention mechanisms over standard attention is not fully substantiated in the abstract.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Leakage-free pipeline with proper data isolation improves reliability
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; stable variance across random seeds with error-bar analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multi-level nonlinear feature interactions are captured better by LOP-Net
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; outperforms baselines on multiple telecom datasets

title: LingualX64: a multilingual benchmark for evaluating symmetry and asymmetry in LLM translation
task: Evaluate LLM translation symmetry/asymmetry across 64 languages
key_results: LingualX64 benchmark reveals significant performance disparities across languages; data scarcity and linguistic complexity drive quality differences
comments: Important benchmark for exposing multilingual asymmetries in LLM training, but abstract lacks quantitative performance metrics (e.g., BLEU scores, specific language pairs).

hypotheses.hypothesis: Data scarcity and linguistic complexity create performance disparities in zero-shot LLM translation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; significant performance gaps observed across languages

title: LiRPE 1.0: a modified linformer with relational positional encoding for network intrusion detection
task: Network intrusion detection with interpretable Linformer-based architecture
key_results: LiRPE achieves 99.51% accuracy, 99.28% recall, 98.70% F1-score, 0.9746 MCC on three IoT benchmarks
comments: Well-integrated pipeline combining feature ranking, class imbalance correction, and explainability; relational positional encoding adds modest innovation over base Linformer.

outputs: ranked features, per-sample and global attributions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Relational positional encoding improves capture of temporal dependencies over standard Linformer
hypotheses.result: Implied but not quantitatively isolated; ablation study not reported in abstract

title: Regional drought forecasting in data-scarce regions through a novel cluster-based liquid neural network
task: Regional drought forecasting in data-scarce regions
key_results: Multivariate LNN shows 100%+ improvement in NSE over univariate LNN and 40% over SARIMA; RMSE 0.25 vs. 0.54–0.72 for benchmarks
comments: Elegant cluster-based approach reducing computational burden; evaluation limited to single basin (Lake Urmia) restricts generalizability claims.

inputs: SPEIcr series, exogenous GDM-SPEI variables at optimal lags
GDM grid points (latitude, longitude, elevation, SPEI temporal variation)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multivariate LNN models outperform univariate alternatives on SPEI forecasting
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; >100% NSE improvement demonstrated

title: Enhancing internet of things intrusion detection through high-performance boosting ensemble learning
task: Lightweight intrusion detection for IoT using ensemble learning
key_results: LightGBM achieves 99.9% accuracy, F1-score, and ROC AUC with 612 s training time on 25M records
comments: Strong empirical results on large-scale data; claims of 'lightweight' are undermined by lack of model size or inference latency metrics for edge deployment.

model_io.model: LightGBM, XGBoost, AdaBoost, Random Forest, Naïve Bayes, Logistic Regression

hypotheses.hypothesis: Ensemble boosting methods minimize false negatives and false positives better than simpler models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; LightGBM and ensemble techniques outperform baselines

title: Evaluating the role of cost and fairness in machine learning models of suicide risk
task: Suicide risk prediction with cost-fairness optimization
key_results: XGBoost achieves AUPRC 0.667 (hospital discharge) and 0.558 (commercial claims) with high PPV; no algorithmic bias by age, sex, race
comments: Rigorous evaluation of precision-recall tradeoff and fairness considerations; class imbalance acknowledged as fundamental limitation for clinical utility.

model_io.model: XGBoost, Random Forest, MLP, Logistic Regression
inputs: Maryland Suicide Datawarehouse: hospital discharge and commercial claims records

hypotheses.hypothesis: AUPRC-optimized ML models outperform logistic regression on suicide risk prediction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; XGBoost especially improved on AUPRC metric

hypotheses.hypothesis: No algorithmic bias exists across demographics (age, sex, race)
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; no bias detected, but performance varies by clinical characteristics

title: Advanced semi-analytical techniques for fractional shallow water wave models through the analogical structure of generalized $$\phi$$-Caputo derivative operators
task: Semi-analytical solution of fractional shallow water wave equations
key_results: φ-CRPSM and φ-CNIM methods generate rapidly convergent fractional power-series solutions with high accuracy; close agreement with exact solutions in integer-order limit
comments: Theoretically rigorous extension of classical methods to generalized φ-Caputo operators; practical applicability to real physical systems not demonstrated with experimental validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Analogical structure of φ-Caputo operator enables systematic solution generation without linearization
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; methods demonstrated on nonlinear fractional systems

title: Deep learning-assisted ultrathin broadband vanadium dioxide-based polarization-insensitive terahertz metamaterial absorber
task: Design broadband terahertz metamaterial absorber using VO2 with deep learning optimization
key_results: Absorptivity >90% over 2.66–6.48 THz (83.6% relative bandwidth); ultrathin thickness 0.062λ; Residual MLP achieved highest prediction accuracy (R²) with lowest error metrics
comments: Deep learning applied post-design for optimization rather than discovery; practical performance metrics are strong but angle/polarization insensitivity claims rely on symmetry arguments needing experimental validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Complementary plus array geometry with VO2 enables broadband absorption via distributed resonances
hypotheses.result: Parametric analysis confirmed electric, magnetic fields and surface currents collectively explain 83.6% bandwidth absorption

hypotheses.hypothesis: Deep learning models can predict optimal absorber parameters with high accuracy
hypotheses.result: Residual MLP outperformed MLP and DCN in 5- and 10-fold cross-validation
